description: Apple Preview on macOS via a use.computer remote sandbox. Preview is preinstalled on macOS so install_preview.sh only verifies the bundle. setup_preview.sh suppresses first-launch dialogs (open-recent, iCloud document picker) and pre-creates ~/Documents where per-task source/output files live. Tasks cover image rotation, PDF page manipulation, and annotation workflows — verifiable via `sips` for image dimensions, `mdls` / `mdimport` for metadata, file mtimes, and (for PDFs) `pdfinfo` / Python `pikepdf`.
